sections.en: The transfer of Mercury to the signs

summary.headline: Mercury’s Transfer and Rainy Signs
summary.text: Judgments of Venus entering Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, including effects on winds, moisture, rain, disease, famine, shipping, social groups, and food prices. Chapter Six explains Mercury’s transfer between signs, citing Kushyar ibn Labban al-Jili and Muhyi al-Din Yahya ibn Muhammad ibn Abi al-Shukr al-Maghribi, and identifies the rainy signs.
